news.titleEn: Trump Says Hormuz Deal Could Be Agreed Wednesday or Thursday as He Hails 'Very Good' Iran Talks
news.conclusionEn: President Trump said the US and Iran could reach a deal within days to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said an agreement could come 'today or tomorrow.'
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称美伊或数日内就重开霍尔木兹海峡达成协议。
news.whyEn: A reopening deal would ease nearly two months of disrupted oil shipping through one of the world's most critical energy chokepoints, directly affecting oil prices and global trade.
news.whyZh: 协议若达成将缓解霍尔木兹海峡航运中断，直接影响油价与全球贸易。
news.detailEn: Trump told reporters in California that talks with Iran have been 'very good' and that an agreement covering the Strait of Hormuz 'could happen... tomorrow or the next day.' Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent echoed the optimism, saying a deal to restore 'freedom of movement' through the strait could be reached within a day or two. Iran's foreign minister said separately that negotiations with Oman, acting as mediator, are in their 'final stages,' though Tehran insists the waterway will never fully return to its pre-war status. The strait has seen sharply reduced traffic since the US-Iran conflict escalated, contributing to elevated oil prices and shipping delays worldwide.
news.detailZh: 特朗普在加州对记者表示，与伊朗的谈判「非常顺利」，围绕霍尔木兹海峡的协议「明天或后天就可能达成」。美国财长贝森特也持乐观态度，称恢复海峡「自由通行」的协议可能在一两天内敲定。伊朗外长则表示，在阿曼斡旋下的谈判已进入「最后阶段」，但德黑兰坚称海峡不会完全恢复到战前状态。自美伊冲突升级以来，该海峡航运量大幅减少，推高全球油价并造成航运延误。

news.titleEn: Stock Market Today: Dow and S&P 500 Edge Higher as Trump Says Hormuz Deal Is Close, Nasdaq Digests Tech Earnings
news.conclusionEn: The S&P 500 and Dow extended a four-day rally toward record territory as hopes for a Strait of Hormuz deal and strong AI-driven earnings lifted sentiment, even as investors digested a mixed batch of tech results.
news.conclusionZh: 标普与道指延续四日涨势，逼近历史高位。
news.whyEn: A multi-session rally to record highs, driven by easing Middle East tensions and continued AI investment demand, signals broad risk-on sentiment across global markets.
news.whyZh: 中东局势缓和及AI投资需求推动美股连续上涨，反映全球市场风险偏好回升。
news.detailEn: US stock futures rose Wednesday, extending a rally that has added roughly 1,600 points to the Dow over the past two sessions, as easing Middle East tensions combined with a wave of corporate earnings dominated by AI infrastructure spending. Nvidia advanced in premarket trading after a key partner reported a sharp jump in monthly sales, while cloud-networking firm Arista Networks surged as much as 14% on a stronger-than-expected revenue forecast. Major companies including Disney, Eli Lilly, Uber and Shopify were also due to report earnings, adding to a packed trading day. Oil prices remained a key focus as traders weighed the odds of a Hormuz reopening deal.
news.detailZh: 周三美股期货上涨，延续过去两个交易日为道指带来约1600点涨幅的行情，中东局势缓和叠加以AI基建支出为主线的财报季共同提振市场情绪。英伟达在盘前交易中上涨，此前一家主要合作伙伴公布月度销售额大幅增长；云网络公司Arista Networks因营收预测好于预期一度飙升14%。迪士尼、礼来、Uber及Shopify等多家大型公司当日也将公布财报，令交易日更加密集。油价仍是市场焦点，交易员正在权衡霍尔木兹海峡重开协议达成的可能性。

news.titleEn: World Bank Sees Weakest Global Growth Since the Pandemic
news.conclusionEn: The World Bank cut its 2026 global growth forecast to 2.5%, citing high inflation and energy-price shocks from the Iran war, marking the weakest expansion since the COVID-19 pandemic.
news.conclusionZh: 世界银行下调2026年全球增速预期至2.5%，为疫情以来最弱。
news.whyEn: A broad global growth downgrade driven by an active war and energy shock affects investment decisions, borrowing costs and trade flows across both developed and developing economies.
news.whyZh: 全球增长预期因战争及能源冲击下调，将影响各国投资、借贷成本及贸易。
news.detailEn: The World Bank lowered its 2026 global growth forecast by 0.1 percentage point to 2.5%, pointing to elevated inflation and rising energy prices after shipping through the Strait of Hormuz was virtually halted by the Iran war. Developing economies have borne the brunt of the shock, with the bank projecting their growth to slow to a post-pandemic low of 3.6%, down from 4.4% in 2025. The bank warned that prolonged disruption to energy markets could further weigh on trade-dependent economies, particularly in Asia and Africa, which rely heavily on stable oil and shipping costs.
news.detailZh: 世界银行将2026年全球增长预期下调0.1个百分点至2.5%，原因是伊朗战争导致霍尔木兹海峡航运几近停摆，推高通胀与能源价格。发展中经济体受冲击最为严重，世行预计其增速将放缓至疫情后新低3.6%，低于2025年的4.4%。世行警告称，若能源市场持续受扰，将进一步拖累严重依赖稳定油价与航运成本的贸易依赖型经济体，尤其是亚洲和非洲国家。

news.titleEn: SpaceX Is Falling After Posting First Earnings Report Since IPO. What the Biggest Wall Street Firms Are Saying
news.conclusionEn: SpaceX reported its first earnings as a public company with revenue up 92% to $7.8 billion, beating estimates, but shares tumbled more than 12% as AI-related capital spending soared to over $23 billion in the first half of the year.
news.conclusionZh: SpaceX首份财报营收超预期增92%，但AI支出激增致股价重挫逾12%。
news.whyEn: A revenue beat failing to prevent a double-digit stock drop shows investors are increasingly wary of runaway AI infrastructure spending, a concern spreading across major tech and space companies.
news.whyZh: 营收超预期仍股价大跌，显示投资者对AI基建支出失控的担忧正蔓延。
news.detailEn: SpaceX posted second-quarter revenue of $7.8 billion, up 92% year-over-year and well above the $6.8 billion analysts expected, but the company remained unprofitable with a $541 million net loss following a $4.3 billion loss in the first quarter. Capital spending jumped to about $18.4 billion for the quarter, pushing first-half AI-related spending above $23 billion, up from just $3.3 billion a year earlier. Shares fell roughly 7% in initial after-hours trading and extended losses to more than 12% the following day as investors focused on the scale of AI investment rather than the revenue beat. Wall Street analysts remained split on whether the spending signals confidence in long-term AI demand or unsustainable cash burn.
news.detailZh: SpaceX第二季度营收达78亿美元，同比增长92%，远超分析师预期的68亿美元，但公司仍未盈利，净亏损5.41亿美元，此前第一季度亏损43亿美元。当季资本支出跃升至约184亿美元，推动上半年AI相关支出超过230亿美元，较去年同期的33亿美元大幅增长。股价在盘后交易中一度下跌约7%，次日跌幅扩大至逾12%，投资者更关注AI投资规模而非营收超预期。华尔街分析师对这笔支出究竟反映对AI长期需求的信心，还是不可持续的现金消耗，看法不一。

news.titleEn: Uber's Robotaxi Ambition to Face Scrutiny as Shares Languish
news.conclusionEn: Uber reported second-quarter gross bookings of $58 billion, up 24% year-over-year, but forecast weak current-quarter profit and shares fell as the company committed to spending over $10 billion on autonomous vehicles.
news.conclusionZh: Uber预订量强劲但盈利指引疲软，股价下跌，加码百亿美元投入自动驾驶。
news.whyEn: Uber's stock decline despite strong bookings growth shows investors questioning whether heavy robotaxi investment will pay off before competitors like Waymo and Tesla gain more ground.
news.whyZh: Uber预订量强劲仍股价下跌，显示投资者担忧自动驾驶巨额投入的回报前景。
news.detailEn: Uber's gross bookings rose 24% year-over-year to $58 billion in the second quarter, but the company forecast current-quarter adjusted earnings below Wall Street estimates, citing foreign-exchange headwinds. Shares fell about 3% in premarket trading and have now slumped 28% since an October record high, even as the S&P 500 gained 15% over the same period. Despite the weak guidance, Uber outlined plans to spend more than $10 billion on autonomous vehicles in coming years without giving a specific timeline, and confirmed its exclusivity robotaxi partnership with Waymo in Atlanta and Austin will end by early 2028, opening the door to more competition.
news.detailZh: Uber第二季度总预订额同比增长24%至580亿美元，但公司预计本季度调整后盈利将低于华尔街预期，原因是外汇因素拖累预订增速。股价在盘前交易中下跌约3%，自去年10月创下历史高位以来已累计下跌28%，同期标普500指数则上涨15%。尽管盈利指引疲软，Uber仍表示未来几年将投入逾100亿美元用于自动驾驶，但未给出具体时间表，并证实其与Waymo在亚特兰大和奥斯汀的独家机器人出租车合作将于2028年初结束，为更多竞争对手打开大门。

news.titleEn: Trump's Tariffs Were Supposed to Boost American Manufacturing, But the New Levies Are Actually Pushing Some Companies Back to China
news.conclusionEn: Some US companies that shifted production away from China during earlier tariff hikes are now reconsidering, as China's tariff rate has fallen closer to those of alternative manufacturing hubs like Vietnam and Thailand.
news.conclusionZh: 部分美企因中国关税降至与东南亚相近水平，正考虑重返中国生产。
news.whyEn: The reversal shows tariff policy is not reliably reshoring manufacturing to the US as intended, instead just reshuffling supply chains among China and Southeast Asian countries.
news.whyZh: 关税政策未推动制造业回流美国，反而让供应链在中国与东南亚间转移。
news.detailEn: When US tariffs on Chinese goods spiked to 145% last year, companies scrambled to find cheaper manufacturing alternatives in Vietnam, Thailand and elsewhere. But under Trump's more recent Section 301 tariffs, China and Vietnam now face a similar 12.5% rate, while Cambodia, Indonesia and Malaysia sit at 10%, narrowing the cost advantage of leaving China. Texas-based flashlight company Alliance Consumer Group, which had encouraged its Chinese manufacturer to build a Thailand factory, is now reconsidering that shift. Analysts say that for companies relying on China's dense supplier networks and established shipping channels, staying — or returning — can once again make economic sense.
news.detailZh: 去年美国对华关税一度飙升至145%，促使企业争相寻找越南、泰国等更低成本的替代产地。但在特朗普近期实施的301条款关税下，中国与越南关税率已趋同至12.5%，柬埔寨、印尼、马来西亚则为10%，令「撤离中国」的成本优势明显收窄。总部位于德州的手电筒企业Alliance Consumer Group此前曾推动其中国代工厂在泰国建厂，如今正重新考虑这一决定。分析师指出，对于依赖中国密集供应商网络及成熟航运渠道的企业而言，留在中国、甚至重返中国，如今又变得具有经济合理性。

news.titleEn: Ebola Deaths Top 1,700 in Eastern Congo
news.conclusionEn: Ebola has killed more than 1,700 people in eastern Congo out of 3,802 recorded cases, making it the second-largest outbreak of the virus on record.
news.conclusionZh: 刚果东部埃博拉疫情死亡人数超1700人，为史上第二大规模疫情。
news.whyEn: The unusually fast spread of one of the world's deadliest viruses raises the risk of cross-border transmission and could strain international health resources already stretched by other crises.
news.whyZh: 疫情异常快速蔓延，增加跨境传播风险，或加重国际公共卫生资源负担。
news.detailEn: The outbreak, first confirmed in May in Congo's remote Ituri province, has grown into the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record, with cases reaching current levels in a fraction of the time it took previous outbreaks. Ituri accounts for nearly 90% of all cases, but the virus has spread to five other provinces, including the major city of Kisangani. Health officials say the outbreak's rapid trajectory — surpassing 1,000 deaths by July 22 and topping 1,700 within two weeks — reflects weak local health infrastructure and difficulty reaching remote communities with vaccines and treatment.
news.detailZh: 该疫情于5月首次在刚果偏远的伊图里省确诊，如今已发展为有记录以来第二大埃博拉疫情，达到当前规模所用时间远短于以往历次疫情。伊图里省占全部病例近90%，但病毒已扩散至另外五个省份，包括大城市基桑加尼。卫生官员表示，疫情蔓延速度之快——7月22日死亡人数破千，两周内又突破1700——反映出当地医疗基础设施薄弱，且疫苗与治疗资源难以覆盖偏远社区。

news.titleEn: At Least 27 Killed as Russia and Ukraine Trade Heavy Attacks
news.conclusionEn: Russia and Ukraine exchanged heavy drone and missile strikes over the weekend, killing at least 27 people combined, including children, as the war shows no sign of a diplomatic breakthrough.
news.conclusionZh: 俄乌互相发动猛烈袭击，合计至少27人死亡，战事仍无外交突破。
news.whyEn: Continued heavy casualties on both sides, including strikes hitting civilian and resort areas inside Russia, underscore how far a ceasefire remains even as diplomatic attention is focused on the Middle East.
news.whyZh: 双方伤亡持续攀升，显示停火仍遥遥无期，即便外交焦点已转向中东。
news.detailEn: Russian state news agency TASS reported five people killed and six injured in a drone attack on the Moscow region, while seven people, including three children, died and nearly 40 were wounded when drone debris struck the resort village of Arkhipo-Osipovka near Gelendzhik. Ukraine also reported casualties from Russian strikes in the same period. The exchange is part of a broader pattern of near-daily long-range strikes by both sides that have increasingly targeted energy and export infrastructure, including facilities tied to Kazakhstan's Black Sea oil exports, adding pressure to global energy markets.
news.detailZh: 俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社报道，莫斯科地区一次无人机袭击造成5人死亡、6人受伤；格连吉克附近的度假村阿尔希波-奥西波夫卡则因无人机残骸坠落造成7人死亡（含3名儿童），近40人受伤。乌克兰方面同期也报告了俄军袭击造成的伤亡。此次交火是双方近乎每日互相发动远程打击的一部分，打击范围日益扩大至能源与出口基础设施，包括与哈萨克斯坦黑海石油出口相关的设施，进一步加剧全球能源市场压力。

businessTips.explanationEn: Opportunity cost is the value of the next-best alternative you give up when choosing one option over another. It applies to money, time and resources alike — every decision to do one thing is implicitly a decision not to do something else. Skilled managers weigh opportunity costs explicitly rather than only counting direct expenses, since ignoring them can lead to choices that look 'free' but quietly waste resources.
businessTips.explanationZh: 机会成本是指选择某一方案时，所放弃的次优方案的价值。它适用于金钱、时间和资源——做出一个选择，本质上也是放弃了其他可能性。优秀的管理者会明确权衡机会成本，而不仅仅计算直接支出，因为忽视机会成本可能导致看似「免费」实则悄悄浪费资源的决策。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company using its own warehouse space to store slow-moving inventory isn't paying rent, so the cost looks like zero. But that space could otherwise be leased out for $20,000 a month — that forgone income is the true opportunity cost of keeping the inventory there.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司用自有仓库存放周转缓慢的库存，因为不用付租金，看起来成本为零。但这块空间原本可以以每月2万美元出租——这笔本可赚取却放弃的收入，才是继续囤货的真实机会成本。

businessTips.explanationEn: A minimum viable product is the simplest version of a new product or service that still lets a founder test a core assumption with real customers. Rather than spending months building every feature before launch, founders release something basic and use real user feedback to decide what to build next. This reduces wasted effort and capital by validating demand before over-investing.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品（MVP）是指新产品或服务的最简版本，足以让创始人用真实客户验证核心假设。创始人无需花费数月打磨所有功能才上线，而是先推出一个基础版本，再根据真实用户反馈决定接下来该做什么。这样能在过度投入前先验证需求，减少精力和资金的浪费。
businessTips.exampleEn: Instead of building a full mobile app for a meal-kit side business, a founder starts by manually taking orders through a simple online form and delivering meals herself for a few weeks. The manual process reveals which recipes sell and what customers actually want, before she invests in packaging, a real app or hired staff.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位创始人没有为她的预制菜副业开发完整手机应用，而是先用一个简单的在线表单手动接单，并亲自配送几周。这个手动流程让她摸清了哪些菜品畅销、客户真正想要什么，之后才投入包装设计、正式应用开发或雇人。

businessTips.explanationEn: Safe-haven assets are investments that investors expect to hold or gain value during periods of market stress, geopolitical conflict or economic uncertainty — commonly gold, US Treasury bonds, and certain currencies like the Swiss franc or Japanese yen. They typically have low correlation with stocks, so holding some can cushion a portfolio when riskier assets sell off. No asset is a guaranteed hedge in every crisis, so investors usually treat safe havens as one part of diversification rather than a complete solution.
businessTips.explanationZh: 避险资产是指在市场动荡、地缘冲突或经济不确定时期，投资者预期能保值甚至升值的资产，常见的有黄金、美国国债，以及瑞士法郎、日元等特定货币。它们通常与股票的相关性较低，因此持有一定比例可以在风险资产抛售时为投资组合起到缓冲作用。但没有任何资产能在每次危机中都稳赚不赔，因此投资者通常将避险资产视为分散配置的一部分，而非万能解药。
businessTips.exampleEn: As Middle East tensions and oil-supply disruptions rattled markets this year, gold prices climbed as some investors shifted money out of stocks and into bullion, seeking stability while waiting for geopolitical clarity rather than trying to predict the market's next move.
businessTips.exampleZh: 今年中东局势紧张及石油供应中断令市场承压，部分投资者将资金从股票转向黄金，金价随之上涨——他们并非试图预测市场下一步走势，而是在地缘局势明朗前寻求资产的稳定性。
